name: Diagnosing Bugs
description: Diagnoses hard bugs and performance regressions through a six-phase loop that refuses to theorise until one fast command reproduces the exact symptom.
longDescription:
**6 phases**, secrets redacted throughout:

- **Feedback loop**: **10 ways** to build one command that goes red on this bug, from a failing test to `git bisect run` and a HITL bash script; no hypothesising without one
- **Reproduce + minimise** until every element is load-bearing
- **Hypothesise**: 3–5 ranked, falsifiable predictions shown to you first
- **Instrument**: one variable at a time, `[DEBUG-xxxx]`-tagged logs; perf regressions measure first
- **Fix**: regression test first when a correct seam exists; a missing seam goes to `/improve-codebase-architecture`
- **Cleanup** checklist
